Information we collect

We collect only the minimum data needed to provide and improve the website. This may include browsing data such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited; cookies or similar technologies; and information you voluntarily provide through a contact channel.

How we use information

Information is used to improve site content and experience, understand aggregate usage patterns, respond to requests, and comply with applicable legal obligations.

Third-party services

The website may embed Google Maps for map and location data. Google Analytics only loads when you actively allow analytics on the Cookie settings page. These services have their own privacy policies.

Your rights

Under the GDPR and applicable related rules, you may request access, correction, or erasure of personal data; object to processing; and lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority.
